title: CP-08 context producer to CP-07 writer request
description: Exact local V1 commit-context payload. The expected run and state revision are separate command arguments, not payload fields.
x-invariants: selection.run_id equals brief.run_id and selection.brief_version equals brief.brief_version.
The separate expected run CLI argument equals selection.run_id and brief.run_id; the separate expected revision CLI argument binds the CP-07 state mutation.
The committed selection persists references only. Source excerpts and transient topology are not admitted by this payload. A successful commit removes the private scanner checkpoint.
